SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN noisecanc = 'None' THEN 1 END) as none_cancel,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN noisecanc = 'Passive' THEN 1 END) as passive_cancel,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN noisecanc = 'Active' THEN 1 END) as active_cancel,
  AVG(thdpct) as avg_thd,
  MIN(thdpct) as min_thd,
  MAX(thdpct) as max_thd,
  AVG(audlatms) as avg_latency,
  AVG(noiseisodb) as avg_noise_iso
FROM audioandmedia;

SELECT 
  noisecanc,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  AVG(thdpct) as avg_thd,
  AVG(audlatms) as avg_latency,
  AVG(noiseisodb) as avg_noise_iso
FROM audioandmedia
GROUP BY noisecanc;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN thdpct > 1.5 THEN 1 END) as high_thd,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN thdpct >= 1.0 THEN 1 END) as med_high_thd,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN btversion = '4.0' THEN 1 END) as old_bt,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN surrsnd = 'Stereo' THEN 1 END) as stereo_only,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN eqcount <= 3 THEN 1 END) as low_eq,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN drvszmm <= 40 THEN 1 END) as small_driver,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN spksensedb < 100 THEN 1 END) as low_speaker_sens
FROM audioandmedia;

SELECT 
  thdpct,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM audioandmedia
GROUP BY thdpct
ORDER BY thdpct DESC;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN thdpct > 1.0 THEN 1 END) as above_1,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN thdpct >= 1.5 THEN 1 END) as above_1_5,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN btversion = '4.0' AND noisecanc = 'None' THEN 1 END) as old_bt_no_cancel,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN btversion IN ('4.0', '5.0') AND noisecanc = 'None' THEN 1 END) as older_bt_no_cancel
FROM audioandmedia;

-- Check for devices with high THD (>1%) which in audio engineering typically means poor quality
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN thdpct > 1.0 THEN 1 END) as poor_thd,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN noisecanc = 'None' AND btversion = '4.0' THEN 1 END) as worst_combo,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN noisecanc = 'None' OR btversion = '4.0' THEN 1 END) as either_poor
FROM audioandmedia;

-- Check if thdpct > 1.0 gives us a reasonable set of "poor quality" devices
SELECT * FROM audioandmedia WHERE thdpct > 1.0 LIMIT 5;
